correctness.rationale: A=I+gamma L is positive definite; sorting is continuous piecewise permutation, allowing a global max-of-chambers identity and explicit attaining pairs. Star hub transposition leads to rank-two difference B-A; det(A)=det(B), trace(A^-1 B)=n+1+delta from explicit inverse; nontrivial eigenvalues are reciprocal and have sum 2+delta, implying exact formula. n=1 handled separately. Independent exact arithmetic and exhaustive small chambers checked with provided program (2704 tests). Uniform positive definiteness on mean-zero spaces justifies homogeneous limit.

value.rationale: Provides an exact, all-parameter, nontrivial two-point stability invariant for canonical discrete rearrangement on the simplest branching graph, with all local extremizer chambers and sharp dimensional/coupling/homogeneous regimes. Differentiates graph-gradient perturbation amplification from ordinary permutation-invariant Lp nonexpansivity and from single-input rearrangement energy comparisons; the divergence sqrt(n) for fixed gamma is a structural warning and useful graph-signal stability benchmark.
